structured.answer: Open an account at פסגות ניירות ערך and put the 500 ₪ a month into the fund the page names, "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". After 10 years I'd have about 72,104 ₪.

stuck.why: 'סכום היום' started at 10,000. I had to change it to 0 before the numbers matched what I'm doing.
60,000 in at 7% a year should come to roughly 100k in my head. 72k felt low. The card says 'בכסף של היום', so maybe it's been adjusted somehow, but I didn't dig into it.
I'm not sure the Yelin Lapidot fund is part of the Pesagot pick or just the fund the whole list is about. The page didn't say which fund in the Pesagot box itself.
